title: The Apple Isn't Red. Your Brain Paints It 🍎
caption:
Red doesn't exist out there. It's a label your brain invented.

Light has no color. Three kinds of cells in your eye send signals, and your brain paints the result. Bees see a completely different flower.

Which level broke your brain? 👇

#color #brain #science #stickman #reelsinstagram
